cd /workspace/examples && python3 - <<'EOF'
import base64,struct
for line in ["S1RFU1QAAAADAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAwAAAAJ4MAAAAAQHAAAAAAAAAngxAAAAAQEAAAACeDIAAAABAA==","S1RFU1QAAAADAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAwAAAAJ4MgAAAAEBAAAAAngxAAAAAQEAAAACeDAAAAAEBwAAAA=="]:
    b=base64.b64decode(line)
    print(len(b))
    off=0
    print(b[:5]); off=5
    ver=struct.unpack_from('>I',b,off)[0]; off+=4; print('ver',ver)
    argc=struct.unpack_from('>I',b,off)[0]; off+=4; print('argc',argc)
    for i in range(argc):
        l=struct.unpack_from('>I',b,off)[0]; off+=4
        off+=l
    sl=struct.unpack_from('>II',b,off); off+=8; print('argv',sl)
    oc=struct.unpack_from('>I',b,off)[0]; off+=4; print('objects',oc)
    for i in range(oc):
        l=struct.unpack_from('>I',b,off)[0]; off+=4
        name=b[off:off+l].decode(); off+=l
        l2=struct.unpack_from('>I',b,off)[0]; off+=4
        data=b[off:off+l2]; off+=l2
        print('obj',name,l2,data.hex(' '), int.from_bytes(data,'little'))
    print('trailing',off,len(b))
EOF
